mapper.sql: t.id, t.plan_id, t.data_date, t.status, t.begin_time, t.update_time, t.end_time, t.msg, t.create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT count(DISTINCT plan_id) FROM t_quartz_task_status t where status = 3 and data_date = #{dataDate} and plan_id in
#{id}

SELECT t.id as plan_id, s.id, t.task_name, t.task_cron, t.remark, t.task_type, t.exe_path, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'DATA' ) AS depend_id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'DATA' ) AS data_depend_id, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id AND d.dependency_type = 'CONTROL' ) AS control_depend_id, t.datasource_id, ds.name AS datasource_name, t.datasource_pool_id, dsp.name AS datasource_pool_name, t.task_system, t.theme, t.period, s.data_date, s.STATUS, s.begin_time, s.update_time, s.end_time, s.msg, s.execute_pool_id, s.execute_pool_name, s.execute_datasource_id, s.execute_datasource_name, case when s.status = '3' or s.status = '4' then 'true' else 'false' end as _disabled, s.create_time FROM t_quartz_task t LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_config ds ON ds.id = t.datasource_id LEFT JOIN sys_datasource_pool dsp ON dsp.id = t.datasource_pool_id left JOIN t_quartz_task_status s ON s.plan_id = t.id and s.data_date = #{queryDTO.dataDate} WHERE t.id in
#{id}
SELECT plan_id as planId, data_date as dataDate, status, msg FROM t_quartz_task_status WHERE status = 1
SELECT id, plan_id as planId, data_date as dataDate, status, end_time as endTime FROM t_quartz_task_status WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 3 ORDER BY data_date DESC LIMIT 1
